ephesians.4.p1.b1.text: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:

ephesians.4.p1.b2.text: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

ephesians.4.p1.b3.text: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

ephesians.4.p2.b1.text: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;

ephesians.4.p2.b2.text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism; one God and Father of all, …

ephesians.4.p2.b3.text: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

ephesians.4.p2.b4.text: This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”

ephesians.4.p3.b1.text: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?

ephesians.4.p3.b2.text: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.

ephesians.4.p3.b3.text: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,

ephesians.4.p3.b4.text: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.

ephesians.4.p4.b1.text: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching …

ephesians.4.p4.b2.text: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.

ephesians.4.p4.b3.text: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love …

ephesians.4.p5.b1.text: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.

ephesians.4.p5.b2.text: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.

ephesians.4.p5.b3.text: to put off your former way of life, your old self, …

ephesians.4.p5.b4.text: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

ephesians.4.p6.b1.text: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.

ephesians.4.p6.b2.text: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,

ephesians.4.p6.b3.text: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands,

ephesians.4.p6.b4.text: that he may have something to share with the one in need.

ephesians.4.p7.b1.text: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.

ephesians.4.p7.b2.text: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

ephesians.4.p7.b3.text: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.

ephesians.4.p7.b4.text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
